item.title: At Dream Weekend, the sponsors built the party.
item.description:
At Dream Weekend this summer, the drinks brands didn't just hang banners. They built the lounges, bars and social spaces people spent the night in.
Sponsorship in Jamaica is moving from being seen to being experienced. What that means for your next event budget: link in bio.
Source: Jamaica Observer.
#TheBiggerPicture #DreamWeekend #EventSponsorship #BrandActivation #Jamaica

item.title: Jamaica's creators have a message for brands: influence takes longer than a weekend.
item.description:
One sponsored post, and the soda should sell out by Monday. Jamaican creators say that's the expectation they keep meeting, and it's wasting brands' money.
Influence builds over a season, not a weekend. How to brief creators for results that show: link in bio.
Sources: Jamaica Observer, EMARKETER.
#TheBiggerPicture #CreatorEconomy #InfluencerMarketing #Jamaica

item.title: Jamaicans abroad are paying attention. Are Jamaican brands?
item.description:
Jamaicans abroad sent home US$3.28 billion in the year to March, about 70% of it from the US.
That's an audience with money, loyalty and an appetite for home. So why do so few Jamaican brands market to it? Link in bio.
Sources: Bank of Jamaica via the Gleaner; Jamaica Observer.
#TheBiggerPicture #JamaicanDiaspora #Jamaica #CaribbeanBrands

item.title: Creator Spotlight: JustInJA and the Jamaica beyond the resort gate.
item.description:
Maroon villages, family farms, fishermen at first light. @just_in_ja shows the Jamaica most visitors never reach, and 300,000+ followers come along for it.
Meet the creator who hosted the Tourist Board's "There's Always More to Jamaica" campaign: link in bio.
#TheBiggerPicture #CreatorSpotlight #JustInJA #VisitJamaica #Jamaica

item.title: The billboard business is switching on.
item.description:
In the US, digital billboards are projected to grow 14.5% this year. Printed billboards: 1.5%.
The twist: almost none of that is advertisers switching from print. Screens are bringing in brands that never bought outdoor before. What that means in Jamaica: link in bio.
Source: Guideline, via PPC Land.
